test.create_query: CREATE TABLE json_path_values_text_index ( id UInt64, data JSON( event String, url String, message String, long_value String, tags Array(String), items Array(JSON(max_dynamic_paths = 0, price UInt64, label String)), attrs Map(String, String), max_dynamic_paths = 0), INDEX data_tokens data TYPE text( tokenizer = jsonPathValues(96), dictionary_block_size = 64) GRANULARITY 1 ) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY id % 16 ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO json_path_values_text_index SELECT number, CAST(concat( '{{"event":"event_', toString(number % 64), '","url":"https://app.posthog.com/project/', toString(number), '/events', '","message":"session_', toString(number), '_needle_', toString(number % 4096), '_suffix', '","long_value":"', repeat('long-prefix-', 12), toString(number), '-long-suffix', '","tags":["tag_', toString(number % 64), '","common"],', '"items":[{{"price":', toString(number), ',"label":"item_', toString(number % 64), '"}},{{"price":', toString(number + 1), ',"label":"next_', toString(number % 64), '"}}],', '"attrs":{{"selective":"', if(number % 4096 = 1234, 'match', 'other'), '","common":"value_', toString(number % 64), '","key_', toString(number), '":"row"}}}}') AS JSON( event String, url String, message String, long_value String, tags Array(String), items Array(JSON(max_dynamic_paths = 0, price UInt64, label String)), attrs Map(String, String), max_dynamic_paths = 0)) FROM numbers(500000)
